en.hubeali: From him, from Zakariyya Al Momin, or between him and a man and I do not know except that he narrated to me from Ammar Al Sajistany who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying to a slave of his<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Go and say to the judge: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘A limit of the woman that she can be copulated with by her husband, is a girl of nine years’.
en.sarwar: 4. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Zakariya al-Mu’min or between him and him there is a man whom I do not know except that he narrated to me from ‘Ammar al-Sajistaniy who has said the following:
